caution: Exploratory development tasks and n=5 seeds. No validation accessed. Descriptive bootstrap coverage can be poor at n=5. With six comparisons, even five wins alone cannot establish familywise significance at 0.05.

measurement_event_audit.policy: Score-independent implementation-integrity gate. Keep raw results, withhold affected/ambiguous legacy runs pending documented review or correction. No exclusion based on how well the program scored.

writer_parent_audit.scope: Only emitted redesign directions in modified/adaptive method audits. Native planner target choice was preserved. Distinct directions can share one target. An evolved-target benefit cannot be inferred from seed-target restarts.

resource_audit.caution: Unknown charges remain booked. Confirmed provider totals exclude unknown requests and are not complete billed totals where unknown_count>0. Process wall time and native reported seconds may include receipt waits during worker cleanup. Time to80th recorded evaluation uses actual search-event timestamps and excludes later receipt-only tail; it is withheld if80 calls were not reached.

baseline_parity.caution: Source parity is distinct from identical stochastic histories. Wall-clock scores and prompt timing metrics can differ even with the same initial source and configured algorithm/model seeds.

validity_budget_audit.scope: Completed runs only; first80 evaluator-call ceiling, starting program included. No model calls or evaluations.
validity_budget_audit.limits: Strict nearest timestamp join (<0.1s). Unmatched and ambiguous events remain explicit; they are not assumed invalid. Counts include repeated-code evaluations and are not counts of distinct programs. No causal or five-seed inference from incomplete groups.

allocation_diagnostic.caution: Work-item counts are not candidate-evaluation counts. Native history is a rolling window, not whole-run reward. When successes are absent, posterior sampling cannot learn which arm produces progress; failure counts still change posterior uncertainty. This descriptive audit does not establish that another allocation would improve scores.

reward_signal_audit.caution: Post-hoc training-only diagnostic of observed signal density, not a policy comparison. Different rewards change future sampling and candidates; no claim that a lower threshold improves performance. Concurrent work uses its recorded dispatch frontier. Tiny differences can reflect scorer timing noise.

completed_block_curves.scope: Completed matched task/seed blocks only; individual curves, not pooled inference
